title: On Constructions of full-dimensional absolutely normal sets of uniqueness
summary: We construct a class of homogeneous Cantor-Moran measures with all contraction ratios being reciprocals of integers, and prove that they are pointwise absolutely normal. Our approach relies on methods developed by Davenport, Erd{ő}s and LeVeque and properties of the order of integers in the multiplicative groups. The construction of these measures differs from the class of pointwise absolutely normal self-similar measures introduced by Hochman and Shmerkin, in which dynamical approaches were used.
